candidates.name: Erdheim-Chester disease
support_spans: Dense diffuse cellular infiltrate composed mainly of foamy histiocytic cells and multinucleated Touton cells
candidates.why: The histopathological findings of foamy histiocytic cells and Touton cells are consistent with Erdheim-Chester disease.

candidates.name: Langerhans cell histiocytosis

candidates.why: Although the histopathological findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis, the negative immunohistochemical staining for CD1a and Langerin makes this diagnosis less likely.
